purpose: Primary nuclear topology and fossil-ready selected-lineage backbone
input_representation: One declared QC-passing representative haploid complement per nonhybrid species plus separately labelled A. x zhejiangensis A and B and one validated proteome per outgroup species
orthogroup_engine: OrthoFinder 3 exact version and command frozen per run
locus_policy: Strict one-copy-per-selected-lineage loci for concatenation plus validated multi-copy gene-family trees for the coalescent analysis
concatenation_engine: IQ-TREE 2 partitioned concatenation with ModelFinder and declared support replicates
coalescent_engine: ASTRAL-Pro using copy-to-selected-lineage mapping; exact implementation and version frozen before production
dating_policy: Freeze the accepted selected-lineage topology before MCMCTree; activate only fossil rows whose required bracketing taxa occur in the exact dated alignment
gene_family_policy: CAFE 5 on the dated selected-lineage tree and representative-complement counts including separate A. x zhejiangensis A and B rows; never raw sums of other phased units
pgls_policy: Enabled only after the dated selected-lineage tree and shared/non-shared lineage aggregation pass; retain A. x zhejiangensis A and B without a shared-individual constraint or A-B-pruned sensitivity; run the declared A. rufa and leave-one-lineage-out sensitivities

purpose: Conditionally diagnose phasing contamination orthologue occupancy and placement
input_representation: Run only if unit-level QC or the primary selected-lineage topology reveals an unresolved placement problem; not a mandatory all-unit result
orthogroup_engine: OrthoFinder 3 exact version and command frozen per run
locus_policy: All validated loci; unit suffixes remain visible in alignments and trees
coalescent_engine: ASTRAL-Pro diagnostic mapping may group copies by assembly unit and is never interpreted as species replication

purpose: Test whether the primary topology CAFE or PGLS inference depends on a polyploid or haplotype representative
input_representation: Exactly one predeclared alternative QC-passing complement replaces the primary representative for one nonhybrid species per run; A. x zhejiangensis A and B remain fixed
orthogroup_engine: Same frozen OrthoFinder 3 workflow as species_primary
locus_policy: Rebuild all affected loci; never patch sequences into the primary alignment
concatenation_engine: Same frozen IQ-TREE 2 workflow as species_primary
coalescent_engine: Same frozen ASTRAL-Pro workflow as species_primary
dating_policy: Repeat dating only when the accepted topology or dated input changes; label every run
gene_family_policy: Repeat CAFE 5 with the matching alternative representative counts and dated tree
pgls_policy: Required when the swapped lineage is in the PGLS cohort; rebuild the matching loss row and time tree

purpose: Reproduce the submitted 17-tip gene-family and concatenated-tree analysis without presenting it as the revised primary design
input_representation: Frozen manuscript-era representatives including A. arguta C A. deliciosa D and both A. zhejiangensis parental haplomes
orthogroup_engine: OrthoFinder 2.5.5 plus DIAMOND and DendroBLAST as reported
concatenation_engine: RAxML-NG GTR+G concatenation with 1000 bootstraps as reported
dating_policy: ape chronos with reported TimeTree points only as a labelled reproduction
gene_family_policy: CAFE 4.2 with the submitted count matrix only as a labelled reproduction
